what_this_is: The Workshop rows for tools/listen-for-a-while: a run that listens to the microphone until the person's end time and writes each turn as a heard row as it is said, and a run that hears a recording another of the person's devices made the same way.

payload.label: Listen to the microphone until a time, and keep who said what
payload.job: Listen in on a meeting or a room until a time I give, and keep each person's turn as it is said
payload.description: Records the microphone on this computer until `until`, hears each short piece of it on this computer with the Whisper model the person names, names each turn from the voices people enrolled (tool:enrol-a-voice-or-face; unknown voices keep the same number for the whole listening), and writes one heard row per turn as soon as its piece has been heard: the listening, the device, when it began and ended, the words, who said it, whether it is the person, the voice and how sure the match was. The sound never leaves this computer: pieces are kept in the run's own folder and deleted once heard, and only the words and the names are written. It stops at `until` by itself; the person's AI cancels the run to turn listening off, and what was heard before then is kept. Pause is real: while the listening's listening-switch row says { on: false, since }, nothing said after `since` is kept, however far behind the hearing is, and the run ends at the first piece recorded after it. The person's own recording rules (recording-rule rows and recording_rules) are asked again for every piece, over the facts in recording_facts and the listening's recording-facts row; a piece recorded while they say blocked is let go unheard. Every answer lists what leaves this computer and what stays. The run lasts as long as `until` is from now, up to the row's longest run. The voice-print and listening-voices record kinds are stays_on_this_device: true.

payload.label: Hear a recording another of my devices made
payload.job: Hear a recording one of my other devices made and keep each person's turn in it as that device heard it
payload.description: Reads a recording one of the person's other devices made (`file`, its name or identity in the person's files) through the run's door into the run's own folder, hears it on this computer with the Whisper model the person names, names each turn from the voices people enrolled (tool:enrol-a-voice-or-face), and writes one heard row per turn as tool:listen-for-a-while does, with `device` as the device and times counted from `at` (when the device began recording; now when left out). The same `listening` name continues an earlier listening's unknown voices. The person's recording rules and the listening's listening-switch row are asked as for a live listening. The copy read for hearing is deleted once heard; the person's file is left where it is. Every answer lists what leaves this computer and what stays.
